Can you name all 8 wrist bones? One sentence does it ✋
Carpal bones mnemonic: Sally Left The Party To Take Cathy Home
S = Scaphoid
L = Lunate
T = Triquetrum
P = Pisiform
(forearm row, thumb side → pinky side)
T = Trapezium
T = Trapezoid
C = Capitate
H = Hamate
(finger row, thumb side → pinky side)
Quick test: trapezium or trapezoid, which one sits under your thumb? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Fig. 220, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume
